identityAndPeriods.result: No new conflation found in bounded scan.
retainedLimits: Mixtec westward displacement and Haudenosaunee overextended outline remain explicit public caveats, not repaired borders.
Muisca 1500, Zapotec 1492, Inuit 1500 and Mapuche 1880 endpoints are not treated as historical disappearance.
The two Paleo-Inuit IDs are Newfoundland-focused regional archaeological phases, not separate kingdoms. Earlier Groswater context is distinguished from later Dorset examples.
Dorset approximate Newfoundland ending around 800 CE is region-specific and later than imported endpoints. Cause remains uncertain.
Valdivia polygon is explicitly a broad cultural approximation, not a state boundary.
identityAndPeriods.notPerformed: Did not independently decode all geometry again; inspected supplied geometry witnesses and public cautions. Did not independently re-research every period transition or conquest date.

sourceBudgets.method: Unicode word tokens. Charged overview, any override.summary, each period summary, all items and ending. Aggregated equivalent URLs across source IDs. No override summaries currently present; generating additional summaries during integration requires recalculation.

integrationReview.scope: Read all final narratives and focused review findings. Applied listed corrections, normalized region metadata, retained map_coverage and no unverified successor links. Individual reviewer source checks are described in the original review; no full certification is claimed.
corrections: Retained public outline and identity warnings and distinctions between contemporary writing, older pictorial names and undeciphered traditions.
integrationReview.verification: Structural and budget checks recorded with release. Review is bounded and does not certify every source or imported border.
